summary.tldr: Implements the United Kingdom’s accession to the CPTPP by updating how the agreement is named in Canadian law and changing related Acts.
what_it_does: Updates how the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership is defined or referred to in certain Acts.
Amends other Acts so they match Canada’s obligations under the agreement and the UK accession protocol.
who_it_affects: Canadian businesses that trade under the agreement
Organisations covered by the amended Acts
summary.background: The bill implements the Protocol on the Accession of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland to the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership, done at Auckland and Bandar Seri Begawan on July 16, 2023.
